title: Practise one phrase
description: One hand presses the guitar strings while the learner returns to a short score phrase. Recommended ≥480 px.

title: Submit an existing recording
description: An existing music recording travels into a receiving tray through one clear transfer. This is a conceptual submission illustration, not a product screen. Recommended ≥480 px.

title: Listen for one useful detail
description: A teacher focuses listening on one marked moment in the learner’s recording. The waveform is illustrative and is not an assessment graph. Recommended ≥480 px.

title: A teacher marks the next focus
description: The approved teacher-guidance composition: a pencil marks a bar and a short note gives the next practice focus. Recommended ≥480 px.
status: Approved EN scene / localised VI extension

title: Return with a clear focus
description: Two attempts stay separate and understandable. The same highlighted bar and teacher focus carry into another attempt; there is no score or guaranteed improvement. Recommended ≥480 px.

title: Understand the learning journey
description: A parent holds a learning journal organised around effort, teacher guidance and the next focus. This is a conceptual communication image, not an available parent-report screen. Recommended ≥480 px.
